exposure: Uteroplacental insufficiency (UPI) induced via permanent ligation of uterine arteries
outcome: Oxidative stress biomarkers (8-hydroxy-2'-deoxyguanosine, protein carbonyl, 4-hydroxy-2-nonenal, malondialdehyde)
Inflammatory cytokines (interleukin-6 [IL-6], IL-1b, tumor necrosis factor-alpha [TNF-a], IL-10)
Neuronal density in the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC)
cohort: Twenty pregnant Wistar rats were randomly assigned to four groups: Control, Sham Surgery, UPI + Vehicle, and UPI + FA.
finding: Pre-treatment with ferulic acid before uteroplacental insufficiency induction mitigated oxidative stress, modulated the Akt/GSK-3b signaling pathway, suppressed neuroinflammation, and preserved cortical integrity in the fetal brain.
